mapper.select: SELECT T.ID, T.TEMPLATE_TYPE_ID, TT.CODE AS TEMPLATE_TYPE, TT.NAME AS TEMPLATE_TYPE_NAME, T.CODE, T.BUCKET_NAME, T.OBJECT_NAME, T.STATUS FROM E_PRINT_TEMPLATE T LEFT JOIN E_PRINT_TEMPLATE_TYPE TT ON TT.ID = T.TEMPLATE_TYPE_ID WHERE T.ID = #{id}

SELECT T.ID, T.TEMPLATE_TYPE_ID, TT.CODE AS TEMPLATE_TYPE, TT.NAME AS TEMPLATE_TYPE_NAME, T.CODE, T.BUCKET_NAME, T.OBJECT_NAME, T.STATUS FROM E_PRINT_TEMPLATE T LEFT JOIN E_PRINT_TEMPLATE_TYPE TT ON TT.ID = T.TEMPLATE_TYPE_ID WHERE T.TEMPLATE_TYPE_ID = #{templateTypeId} AND T.CODE = #{templateCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO E_PRINT_TEMPLATE ( ID, TEMPLATE_TYPE_ID, CODE, BUCKET_NAME, OBJECT_NAME, STATUS ) VALUES ( SEQ_E_PRINT_TEMPLATE.NEXTVAL, #{templateTypeId}, #{templateCode}, #{bucketName}, #{objectName}, #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE E_PRINT_TEMPLATE SET TEMPLATE_TYPE_ID = #{templateTypeId}, CODE = #{templateCode}, BUCKET_NAME = #{bucketName}, OBJECT_NAME = #{objectName}, STATUS = #{status} WHERE ID = #{id}
